title: 運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證
summary: 以運輸機縮尺外形的風洞驗證建立完整資料鏈：幾何、相似性、支架皮重、壓力、天平和不確定度。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Build a complete wind-tunnel evidence chain for a scale transport shape: geometry, similarity, support tare, pressures, balance and uncertainty. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 模型幾何與投影面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Model geometry and projected area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 模型幾何與投影面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Model geometry and projected area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 展弦比以翼展平方除參考面積，表達有限翼三維效應；縮尺模型保留幾何比例不會自動保留流動相似性。
steps.instructionEn: Aspect ratio is span squared divided by reference area and describes finite-wing geometry; geometric scaling alone does not preserve flow similarity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證實際性能或製程：翼展b=12 m，面積S=18 m²。式 AR=b²/S，基準結果 8 dimensionless。適用條件：投影翼面積且翼展定義一致；不是翼梢形狀的完整模型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Transport-aircraft wind-tunnel validation: Span b=12 m and reference area S=18 m². Formula AR=b²/S gives 8 dimensionless. Conditions: Consistent projected area and span definitions; not a full model of wingtip geometry.
steps.failure: 混用單翼面積與全翼翼展會把展弦比放大兩倍。
steps.failureEn: Combining half-wing area with full span doubles the calculated aspect ratio.
steps.check: 在同一投影圖量翼展與面積，把翼梢裝置的投影規則列在表格。
steps.checkEn: Measure span and area on one projection and document how wingtip devices are included.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再面積固定，僅把b改成13 m；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 8 改為 9.38888889 dimensionless。在算式區重算並記下對「模型幾何與投影面積」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Hold area fixed and change only b to 13 m, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 8 to 9.38888889 dimensionless. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Model geometry and projected area, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證」的「模型幾何與投影面積：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Model geometry and projected area: Mechanism and observation” in “Transport-aircraft wind-tunnel validation”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.titleEn: Size reduction and similarity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 尺寸縮減與相似性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Size reduction and similarity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 雷諾數比較慣性與黏滯作用，決定邊界層及轉捩條件；小模型與原型的速度相同不代表流場相似。
steps.instructionEn: Reynolds number compares inertia and viscosity and affects boundary layers and transition; equal model and full-scale speed does not imply similar flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，弦長c=0.5 m，μ=1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s。式 Re=ρVc/μ，基準結果 1000000 dimensionless。適用條件：單一參考長度與定物性，尚須同時檢查馬赫數與粗糙度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Transport-aircraft wind-tunnel validation: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, chord c=0.5 m and mu=1.8e-5 Pa·s. Formula Re=ρVc/μ gives 1000000 dimensionless. Conditions: One reference length and constant properties; Mach number and roughness also require checks.
steps.failure: 把公分當公尺會造成100倍誤差；只靠Re相同也不能消除風洞壁效應。
steps.failureEn: Treating centimetres as metres creates a factor-of-100 error; matching Re does not remove tunnel-wall effects.
steps.check: 保留風洞溫度、密度、黏度計算與弦長，對照轉捩位置或邊界層資料。
steps.checkEn: Retain tunnel temperature, density, viscosity calculation and chord, and compare transition or boundary-layer evidence.
